title: Choose the visual world for The Tooth Care
question: The roll assigned The Evening Tea Stall. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Evening Tea Stall
options.lineage: Dhaka tong dokan adda at dusk: bench, glass cups of milk cha, hand-painted tin sign, bare bulbs
options.thesis: You do not enter a clinic; you sit down on the bench next to Dr. Uzzal and talk first.
options.viewport: Phone-first: a dusk-indigo field with a warm bulb pool of light. Dr. Uzzal's candid portrait at eye height on the left of a bench, the empty seat beside him is the invitation. His one-line welcome in painted-sign lettering: 'Sit. Tell me what is bothering you.' Under it, one amber pill: 'Message Dr. Uzzal on WhatsApp', and a quiet 'Call' link. The existing logo sits top-left in its own blue, the word dentist visible in the first line so the page never reads as a cafe.
options.risk: Reads as a tea brand or a cafe if the dentist facts are not in the first viewport; the tin-sign lettering turns kitsch if overused beyond headings.

raised.raise: The doctor's portrait meets the visitor's eye at real phone eye height in viewport one, no hero card shell around it.
One signal colour, tea amber, does every calling on the page; nothing else asks for a tap.
Each home section owns exactly one claim and never restates another section's.
Body copy runs in horizontal courses with a fixed 60-character measure, one rhythm down the whole page.
The next step is always lit: every section ends in the next thing to do, and the message bar never leaves the screen on mobile.

options.label: The Prescription Pad
options.lineage: A Bangladeshi doctor's personal letterhead pad, blue ballpoint, kept in a drawer for years
options.thesis: The whole site is a note written to you on Dr. Uzzal's own pad.
options.viewport: A single tall sheet: the letterhead (logo, name, degrees, both chambers, hours) printed in navy across the top, then the welcome handwritten-in-tone in ballpoint blue, his portrait clipped to the corner like a passport photo. The WhatsApp action is the one red stamp on the sheet.
options.risk: Warm paper stationery is where most warm clinic sites drift; it reads nostalgic and generic if the pad is set timidly or the letterhead is not real.

options.label: The Sliding Room
options.lineage: Rietveld Schröder house: sliding primary planes reconfigure one small room
options.thesis: One honest room where every plane slides to show you exactly what happens next.
options.viewport: White and grey planes with black frame lines; the doctor's portrait is one plane, his welcome a text rectangle flush to its edge. Logo blue marks only the edges that slide: swipe the plane and the first-visit steps open in place of the hero.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: honest joints match honest explanation and each slide reveals one step. Loses on identification: Dhaka patients do not see themselves in De Stijl.
options.risk: Reads as a design museum, cold, unless warmth comes from real photography inside the planes.

options.label: Cereal Aisle
options.lineage: supermarket planogram wall of saturated boxes
options.thesis: Services as a shelf of boxes competing for your eye.
options.viewport: A shelf grid of service boxes with NEW bursts.
options.case: Shelf hype and violators are the exact sales pressure the brand refuses.
options.kept: The portrait meets your eye at eye height, at real scale.

options.label: Jackfield Schedule
options.lineage: normalling schedule on black glass, amber lanes
options.thesis: Your care plan as numbered amber lanes.
options.viewport: Numbered lanes, one amber tie line per fact.
options.case: Machine-room grammar; no patient identifies with it and a persuade page has no states to normal.
options.kept: One signal colour does every calling.

options.label: Night Six-Pack
options.thesis: Six calm dials you trust through the cloud.
options.viewport: Two rows of three gauges, each one fact.
options.case: Trust through fear resonates, but aviation is foreign to the audience and dentistry has no live readings.
options.kept: Each section owns exactly one truth.

options.label: Coiled Earth Tower
options.thesis: Years of care laid down as visible courses.
options.viewport: Text banded in horizontal clay courses.
options.case: Bengal knows terracotta, but a dentist rendered as a tower loses clarity fast.
options.kept: Horizontal courses with a fixed measure, one rhythm.
options.risk: Heavy and earthen for a mouth.

options.label: Luminescent Understory
options.thesis: The path lights itself as you approach.
options.case: Sci-fi glow contradicts a plain, honest human voice.
options.kept: The next step is always lit two steps ahead.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The dental clinic site every competitor ships, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Hero with a smiling patient and 'Book appointment', a row of trust badges, a service icon grid, doctor bio, map.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the neighbouring clinics by design.
